# LiftCamp

> Log workouts fast, track sets and PRs, and know exactly what to lift next. A simple strength-training tracker built for the gym.

LiftCamp is a strength-training log for lifters. It records sets, reps and
weight, estimates one-rep max, detects personal records, suggests your next
session from templates or a Push/Pull/Legs generator, and charts progress over
time. The app itself is behind an account; the exercise library and guides
below are public and free to read.

## Pages

- [Home](https://liftcamp.app/): What LiftCamp does and how to start a workout.
- [About](https://liftcamp.app/about): Who builds LiftCamp and why.
- [Sign in](https://liftcamp.app/login): Create an account or sign in to start logging.

## Exercise library

Each exercise page covers how to do the lift, the muscles it trains, common
beginner mistakes, and sensible starting sets and reps.

- [All exercises](https://liftcamp.app/exercises): Browse by body region or equipment.
- [Chest](https://liftcamp.app/exercises/chest)
- [Back](https://liftcamp.app/exercises/back)
- [Shoulders](https://liftcamp.app/exercises/shoulders)
- [Arms](https://liftcamp.app/exercises/arms)
- [Legs](https://liftcamp.app/exercises/legs)
- [Core](https://liftcamp.app/exercises/core)
